title: Board Clean Refactor
description: Refactor @elements/board and board integration (topology, sketchpad) to be clean: remove legacy APIs, unify naming, consolidate exports, fix inconsistencies, ensure tests pass.
summary: Legacy board/sketchpad paths removed in favor of clean mechanisms: WASM kind-catalog tests use `name` (not `label`); kit board diagram uses topology helpers `topologyKitBoardHandleAngle` and `topologyBoardCenterFromTopLeft`; `schema_gap_surfaces` rebuilt via ticket script (single @names list, explicit `gap_surface_families!` + register with `::paste::paste!`, region bounded to next meta //#region). Tests: @elements/board 80 cargo + 75 vitest + 6 playwright; @elements/topology 14 vitest + 1 playwright; `cargo check -p compose` passes.
